title: Zig 0.16 clearRetainingCapacity corrupts tokenizer buffers
summary: std.ArrayList.clearRetainingCapacity() in Zig 0.16 does @memset(self.items, undefined), which corrupts any TokenIterator that captured the ArrayList's items slice before the clear. In src/gtp.zig, the GTP command loop called clearRetainingCapacity() on the line buffer immediately after creating a tokenizer, causing all command tokens to be garbage and every GTP command to return '? unknown command'.
fix: Move line.clearRetainingCapacity() to after all tokenizer usage is complete (after out.clearRetainingCapacity(), before the next iteration).
impact: The weizigo-gtp binary was completely non-functional when compiled with Zig 0.16. The existing bin/weizigo-oracle was compiled with an older Zig and was not affected.
